sub_indicators.label: Online participation in policy
sub_indicators.subject: include.access
sub_indicators.text: Citizen participation in policy: online participation in policy
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Charter on Democracy, Elections and Governance asks for citizen participation in the development process; the UN E-Participation Index measures it online.
criteria: A source from the past three years says laws and policies are adopted with no public consultation and no way for citizens to take part.
A ministry, parliament or regulator posted a named draft law, policy or regulation online for public comment, or ran an online consultation or survey on one.
A government consultation portal, e-petition system or online platform for comments on drafts is in service and open to the public for more than one draft.
The government published the comments it received in an online consultation, a report of one, or its answer to them.
A consultation was held online because a law, decree or published procedure requires drafts to be put online for public comment.
